messages.english: Length unit
messages.translation: Yuniti ya ku leha

messages.english: Metres (m)
messages.translation: Timitara (m)

messages.english: Feet (ft)
messages.translation: Swikondzo / Feet (ft)

messages.english: Use decimal numbers with a dot or comma; either is a decimal separator. No digit grouping, fractions or unit suffixes. Direction stays in degrees. Switching units changes entry and display only; saved dimensions remain in metres.
messages.translation: Tirhisa tinomboro ta desimali leti nga na hinkwa kumbe khefana; ha swimbirhi swi tirha tanihi xihambanisi xa desimali (decimal separator). Ku hava ku hlengeletiwa ka tinomboro (digit grouping), swiphemu (fractions) kumbe swilandzelisi swa tiyuniti. Thlelo (direction) ri tshama hi ti-degrees. Ku cinca tiyuniti swi cinca ku nghenisa ni ku kombiwa ntsena; mimpimo leyi hlayisiweke yi tshama hi timitara.

messages.english: Your current entries keep their original unit. Choose a unit explicitly to change it.
messages.translation: Leswi u swi ngheniseke sweswi swi hlayisa yuniti ya swona yo sungula. Hlawula yuniti hi ku kongoma leswaku u yi cinca.

messages.english: Unit choice remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Ku hlawuriwa ka yuniti ku tsundzukiwile eka xitirhisiwa lexi.

messages.english: Unit choice applies only to this sample session.
messages.translation: Ku hlawuriwa ka yuniti ku tirha ntsena eka nkarhi lowu wa xikombiso (sample session).

messages.english: Unit choice works here, but could not be remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Ku hlawuriwa ka yuniti ka tirha laha, kambe a swi kotekanga ku tsundzukiwa eka xitirhisiwa lexi.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal dimensions before changing units. Your entries and their current unit have been kept.
messages.translation: Hetisa mimpimo ya desimali leyi amukelekaka u nga si cinca tiyuniti. Leswi u swi ngheniseke ni yuniti ya swona ya sweswi swi ha tshikiwile eka fomo.

messages.english: The account or sample context changed. Reopen the design to load its field settings.
messages.translation: Xiyimo xa akhawunti kumbe xa xikombiso xi cincile. Pfula nakambe dizayini leswaku u layicha malulamisele ya nsimu ya yona.

messages.english: Checking the account or sample context before showing field settings.
messages.translation: Ku kambisisiwa xiyimo xa akhawunti kumbe xa xikombiso ku nga si kombiwa malulamisele ya nsimu.

messages.english: The saved field, map scale or account context changed. Your draft has been kept. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Nsimu leyi hlayisiweke, xikalo xa mepe (map scale) kumbe xiyimo xa akhawunti xi cincile. Xitsariwa xa wena xo sungula (draft) xi ha tshikiwile eka fomo. Layicha nakambe malulamisele ya nsimu u nga si tirhisa.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal bed and path dimensions before applying.
messages.translation: Hetisa mimpimo ya desimali leyi amukelekaka ya timbhedwa to byala (beds) ni tindlela u nga si tirhisa.

messages.english: Reload field settings
messages.translation: Layicha nakambe malulamisele ya nsimu

messages.english: The field or account context changed. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Xiyimo xa nsimu kumbe xa akhawunti xi cincile. Layicha nakambe malulamisele ya nsimu u nga si tirhisa.

messages.english: Enter field-block bed and path dimensions in metres or feet.
messages.translation: Nghenisa mimpimo ya timbhedwa to byala (beds) ni tindlela ta buloko ya nsimu hi timitara kumbe hi swikondzo (feet).

messages.english: Keep saved measurements unchanged when switching the displayed unit.
messages.translation: Tshika mimpimo leyi hlayisiweke yi nga cincangi loko u cinca yuniti leyi kombiwaka.

messages.english: Choose field-block units
messages.translation: Hlawula tiyuniti ta buloko ya nsimu

messages.english: Site design → Planting → Field blocks
messages.translation: Dizayini ya ndhawu → Ku byala → Tibuloko ta masimu

messages.english: Select a field, choose metres or feet, enter your dimensions and review the beds before saving. Open fields keep their polygon area without generating beds.
messages.translation: Hlawula nsimu, hlawula timitara kumbe swikondzo (feet), nghenisa mimpimo ya wena kutani u kambisisa timbhedwa to byala (beds) u nga si hlayisa. Masimu lama pfulekeke ma hlayisa ndhawu ya wona ya polygon handle ko endla timbhedwa to byala (beds).
